test_title: PYST 231: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 15th Dec,, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The penalty for / not wear masks / in public places / should be increased.
solution:
The correct option is **"not wear masks".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sentence: The penalty for not wearing masks in public areas should be increased.
 
• This is a present continuous tense so 'ing' should be used.
